title: Capricorn: the old way ends,
a steadier love begins
summary: Why love in 2027 asks a Capricorn Moon to let go of old patterns, what begins on December 5, and your love windows for the year with their dates.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Capricorn flag, with the sea-goat beside her
inside: Why your old type and old patterns in love start to loosen
What begins on December 5, and why you may feel restless
Your love windows in 2027, with their dates, and what to do in each
intro: If you are a Capricorn by Moon sign, you are used to doing love the careful way. You choose slowly, you show love by doing things, and you tend to stick with what has worked before. In 2027 the tradition reads that old way as loosening. Not because anything is wrong with you, but because the sky asks you to grow past a pattern.

This guide explains the change that begins on December 5, the months in 2027 that are read as warmest for love, the stretch that takes love deeper, and what to do with each. Nothing here is a promise. It is what Vedic astrology reads from the sky by your Moon sign, and how to use it well.

sections.label: The change
title: Letting go
of the old type.
paragraphs: The tradition pictures a dragon cut in two. Ketu, the south node, is the tail with no head: calm, detached, done with chasing. Rahu, the north node, is the head with no body: all appetite, always wanting something new. The two always sit exactly opposite each other in the sky.

From December 5, 2026, Ketu sits in your house of partnership, the seventh house counted from your Moon sign, and Rahu sits on your own sign. They stay there through the whole of 2027 and until June 23, 2028.

In the house of partnership, Ketu is read as letting go. The old type you always fall for, the role you always play in a relationship, the rules you set for love long ago: these are read as losing their grip. On your own sign, Rahu is read as a strong wish to become someone new. Put together, you are changing fast, and the old way you love no longer quite fits. That can feel restless and in between. The useful side is real: it clears space for a steadier kind of love that suits who you are becoming.

sections.label: December 5
title: The day
it begins.
paragraphs: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, both halves of the dragon change sign at the same moment. Before that day the tail sat in your house of intimacy and the head in your house of money and family. After it, the tail settles into partnership and the head lands on you.

If you notice a shift around that day, less patience for old relationship habits and more curiosity about a different kind of person or a different way of being together, the tradition would say that is the start of this chapter. It is not a reason to end anything. It is a reason to look honestly at what you want.

rows.note: Old patterns in love loosen, all through 2027. A year to notice which habits you keep out of fear and which you keep because they are good.
The planet of luck visits your house of partnership, in the sign the tradition counts as its strongest. Read as the kindest months of the year for meeting someone or steadying what you have.
The slow planet of patience steps into your house of home. Read as a time of chores, repairs or family duties. Keep some calm evenings for the two of you.
The planet of luck moves into your house of intimacy and shared things. Read as love going deeper: honest talks, trust, and sharing more of your life.
The planet of luck moves to your house of beliefs and long journeys. Read as a good time to travel together or plan the bigger picture.

sections.label: The warmest stretch
title: Late January
to late June.
paragraphs: From January 24 until June 25, the planet of luck and growth, Jupiter, sits in Cancer, your house of partnership. Cancer is the sign where the tradition reads this planet at its strongest. You may remember the same visit from June 1 to October 31, 2026; this is it coming back for a second stay.

So for five months the kindest influence in the sky sits in the same house where the quiet tail is clearing out old patterns. The tradition reads this as a gentle hand on the change: the old way goes, and something more generous and more grown up has room to arrive.

If you are single, this is read as the stretch to say yes to the person who does not fit your old list. If you are with someone, it is read as a good time to talk about what you both want now, not what you wanted when you met.

sections.label: Love going deeper
title: Late June
to late November.
paragraphs: From June 25 until November 26, the planet of luck moves into your house of intimacy, the eighth house, which the tradition links to trust, what partners share and what lies under the surface. It is read as a stretch when love asks to go deeper than routine.

For a sign that shows love through actions, this is a good time to add words: say what you feel, ask what your partner needs, share the thing you usually keep to yourself. The same months also bring the slow planet of patience into your house of home from June 2 to October 19, so plan calm time together on purpose.

steps.name: Drop the old script
steps.text: Write down your rules for love: the type you choose, the role you play, what you never say. Ask of each one whether it still serves you. Keep the good ones and let the rest go.

steps.name: Say yes in late January
steps.text: Between January 24 and June 25, accept the invitation, give the unexpected person a proper conversation, or plan something new with your partner. These months are read as kind to it.

steps.name: Add words to your actions
steps.text: You show love by doing. This year, say it as well, especially from late June. One honest sentence about how you feel can mean more than a week of quiet effort.

steps.name: Protect your evenings at home
steps.text: From June 2 to October 19, when home life asks for more work, set aside two calm evenings a week that chores cannot touch.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m a Capricorn Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Capricorn in the Vedic system. Many people who think of themselves as Capricorn have a different Moon sign. You can find yours for free on AstrolGuru with your birth date, time and place.

faq.q: Does this mean my relationship will end?
faq.a: No. The tradition reads the tail of the dragon in partnership as old patterns loosening, not people leaving. Many couples use a year like this to grow up together. Your own birth chart and choices decide the rest.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, Lahiri ayanamsa, read by Moon sign.
